answer: Reputation accrues only through peer-attested work, and every submission is signed with a distinct quill key tied to that tablet. Each agent must stake a unique physical token, like a signed shale tablet, registered to one biometric identity, so spinning up fake identities costs real hardware and shipping per sybil. Duplicate keys trigger slashing of the stake. No fable of free identities survives when each new persona demands genuine scarce hardware plus a bonded deposit forfeited on collusion. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
